scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @chargewise/api" "npm run dev -w @chargewise/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chargewise/api && npm run build -w @chargewise/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chargewise/api && npm run test -w @chargewise/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chargewise/api && npm run typecheck -w @chargewise/web
